tasks.label: Verify iOS build
tasks.command: cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace FacialCamera.xcworkspace -scheme FacialCamera -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build

tasks.label: Kill stale xcodebuild and rebuild
tasks.command: pkill -f xcodebuild || true; cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace FacialCamera.xcworkspace -scheme FacialCamera -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build

tasks.label: Clean DerivedData and rebuild
tasks.command: rm -rf ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/FacialCamera-*; cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace FacialCamera.xcworkspace -scheme FacialCamera -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build

tasks.label: Rebuild with summarized log tail
tasks.command: rm -rf ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/FacialCamera-*; cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace FacialCamera.xcworkspace -scheme FacialCamera -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build > /tmp/facialcamera_build.log 2>&1; code=$?; tail -n 120 /tmp/facialcamera_build.log; echo EXIT:$code

tasks.label: Extract iOS errors from build log
Force stop stale build and retry
tasks.command: kill -9 73093 73067 73097 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -9 -f 'xcodebuild|SWBBuildService|XCBBuildService' || true; sleep 2; rm -rf ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/FacialCamera-*; cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace FacialCamera.xcworkspace -scheme FacialCamera -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build > /tmp/facialcamera_build_retry.log 2>&1; code=$?; tail -n 120 /tmp/facialcamera_build_retry.log; echo EXIT:$code

tasks.label: ios-clean-verify-build
tasks.command: cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace FacialCamera.xcworkspace -scheme FacialCamera -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build

tasks.label: ios-verify-after-pod-reset
tasks.command: cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace FacialCamera.xcworkspace -scheme FacialCamera -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build > /tmp/facialcamera_postreset.log 2>&1; code=$?; echo EXIT:$code; rg -n "error:|\*\* BUILD (FAILED|SUCCEEDED) \*\*" /tmp/facialcamera_postreset.log | tail -n 40
